description: Read one eBay bulk job by the jobId returned from spellbook_ebay_publish or spellbook_ebay_reprice. Both operations queue work, so call this before telling the person a listing was created or its ask changed. State planning, pending, uploading, processing or ingesting means the job is still running: call again after about a minute. State failed carries errorMessage, and each failures row carries a per-card reason: relay that reason to the person. A job with dryRun true is a reprice preview: it changed no eBay price, and totalItems counts the listings a live run would reprice. Returns state, counts, per-card items, failures and missingFields.

context.description: Optional analytics context: describe the user's goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

jobId.description: The jobId returned by spellbook_ebay_publish or spellbook_ebay_reprice. Required.
